## Rule

Two solid yellow(4) rectangles stacked vertically (top above bottom) in the 10×10 active grid, separated by a blank band. Output: keep the yellow borders, fill the **smaller** rectangle's interior with **blue(1)**, the **larger** rectangle's interior with **red(2)**, background stays 0. Small/large is a global (data-dependent) comparison of the two rectangles' sizes.

> NOTE: AUTO STATUS block above (12,991, 67-node F16 Pad graph) is STALE. **LIVE = 977** (QLinearConv `classcode_u8_qlinear3x3_final`, sha `de09544e…`, owner Boladi, shipped 2026-07-10).

## Algorithm sketch

7-node render floor: `Slice` yellow ch4 → `c4_f` F32[1,1,10,10]; `Cast`→`c4` BOOL; `Einsum(c4_f,row_weight)`→orientation → `Greater`→top_small; `Where` selects per-row class codes (top vs bottom); `Where(c4, codes, one_u8)`→2-ch U8 features; `QLinearConv(features, weights[10,2,3,3], bias)` with `pads=[1,1,21,21]` emits UINT8[1,10,30,30] directly — the 30×30 canvas is absorbed into the conv pad (the "FreeOutputPadTail" — already done).
